segment.source: I ain't talkin' to you no more. Lyin' bastard.<end>
segment.target: I ain't talkin' to you no more. Lyin' bastard.<end>

segment.source: Not now.<end>
segment.target: Not now.<end>

segment.source:
::The man gives you a puzzled look.::
What do *you* want?<end>
segment.target:
::The man gives you a puzzled look.::
What do *you* want?<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: Who are you?<end>
segment.target: Who are you?<end>

segment.source: Mr. Get Lost.<end>
segment.target: Mr. Get Lost.<end>

segment.source: How are the dice treating you today?<end>
segment.target: How are the dice treating you today?<end>

segment.source: Mind your own damn business.<end>
segment.target: Mind your own damn business.<end>

segment.source: ::[Persuade]:: Hey, are you Elwood? Someone wants to see you outside.<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuade]:: Hey, are you Elwood? Someone wants to see you outside.<end>

segment.source: Tell 'im I'm busy.<end>
segment.target: Tell 'im I'm busy.<end>

segment.source: *She* says it's really important and that you should see her straight away. She's waiting by that green gas tank, near the side entrance.<end>
segment.target: *She* says it's really important and that you should see her straight away. She's waiting by that green gas tank, near the side entrance.<end>

segment.source: She? But who is this woman? What does she look like?<end>
segment.target: She? But who is this woman? What does she look like?<end>

segment.source: Didn't say her name. But boy does she have a nice round belly.<end>
segment.target: Didn't say her name. But boy does she have a nice round belly.<end>

segment.source: What the...? Belly? ::He grabs his head.:: Alright, alright, I'm comin' out.<end>
segment.target: What the...? Belly? ::He grabs his head.:: Alright, alright, I'm comin' out.<end>

segment.source: Hey! Leave me alone, will ya? I'm busy here.<end>
segment.target: Hey! Leave me alone, will ya? I'm busy here.<end>

segment.source: Fine. I'll leave you to it then.<end>
segment.target: Fine. I'll leave you to it then.<end>

segment.source: ::He gives you a thumbs up and returns to what he was doing.::<end>
segment.target: ::He gives you a thumbs up and returns to what he was doing.::<end>

segment.source: I need the key card to your place.<end>
segment.target: I need the key card to your place.<end>

segment.source: Not right now, baby, I got to win me some cash first. But stick around, perhaps, eh... we can *party* later.<end>
segment.target: Not right now, baby, I got to win me some cash first. But stick around, perhaps, eh... we can *party* later.<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: ::[Intimidate]:: I wasn't asking. Give me the damn key card right now or I'll blow your brains out.<end>
segment.target: ::[Intimidate]:: I wasn't asking. Give me the damn key card right now or I'll blow your brains out.<end>

segment.source: ::Visibly intimidated by your threats, the man takes a step back and reaches for his gun, all the while keeping you in focus with his wide-open, fearful eyes.::<end>
segment.target: ::Visibly intimidated by your threats, the man takes a step back and reaches for his gun, all the while keeping you in focus with his wide-open, fearful eyes.::<end>

segment.source: Fight!<end>
segment.target: Fight!<end>

segment.source: You're messin' with the wrong Scrapper, $(#jack/baby)! ::He reaches for his gun.::<end>
segment.target: You're messin' with the wrong Scrapper, $(#jack/baby)! ::He reaches for his gun.::<end>

segment.source: Your loss.<end>
segment.target: Your loss.<end>

segment.source: ::Leave.::<end>
segment.target: ::Leave.::<end>

segment.source: Sorry, jack, I don't swing that way.<end>
segment.target: Sorry, jack, I don't swing that way.<end>

segment.source: Never mind.<end>
segment.target: Never mind.<end>

segment.source: You again. What do you want? Can'tcha see I'm busy?<end>
segment.target: You again. What do you want? Can'tcha see I'm busy?<end>
